edits.find: Acquiring professional competency in a technical discipline typically requires between 250 to 400 hours of focused deliberate practice. For individuals allocating 15 to 20 hours per week of disciplined study and project building, reaching market-ready proficiency generally spans 12 to 20 weeks. Consistency, hands-on building, and debugging real-world errors are substantially more effective than passive video consumption.

edits.find: The modern digital economy represents a genuine meritocracy of demonstrated capability.
